'''Pipe Bridge''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A logistics unit that lets 2 pipelines intersect without obstructing each other.|This logistics unit is furnished with special fluid control valves developed by Endfield Industries. However, its unique industrial designs have greatly limited its success in the market.}}
==Usage==
A logistics unit that lets 2 pipelines intersect without obstructing each other.

The Pipe Bridge allows a pipeline to go over another without disrupting the flow of fluids in both pipelines.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Fittings]]
